name: Frank Wadsworth
role: Stockman fatally shot by accident at Wadsworth's line camp
bio: Frank Wadsworth was badly wounded in May 1885 at Wadsworth's line camp at the head of Frank's Creek, when a gun in Joe Graham's hands went off accidentally. He died a few days later, and the paper wrote that few deaths were so widely mourned.

moments.label: Died of an accidental gunshot wound
